ohio_outcome: The university laid off 14 staff and took more than 50 voluntary buyouts in August 2024 while closing a $40 million budget gap, and cut three sports in January 2025. It spent $9 million on buyouts. The university remains open and the grant-funded research operations continue.
source: WKYC 2024-08-20; Ideastream 2024-08-20; WKYC 2024-08-26; Cleveland.com 2024-04-09; Ideastream 2025-01-24
notes: Institution-wide budget cuts, not a closure or sale of the grant-funded operation.

name: GENERAL ELECTRIC COMPANY
ohio_outcome: GE Aviation detailed 605 layoffs at its Evendale headquarters in June 2020 during the pandemic collapse in air travel, after the first grant year of 2018. The site stayed open, kept receiving grants in 2023 and 2024, and in September 2026 GE Aerospace agreed to buy an Ohio supplier for $11.8 billion
source: The Business Journals 2020-06-23 'GE Aviation details 605 layoffs at Evendale headquarters'; FOX19 2020-06-23; Cincinnati Enquirer 2026-09-09
notes: The two flagged headlines were about Jacksonville, Florida and a ventilator campaign. The real Ohio cut is the 2020 Evendale layoff, which the site has since more than recovered from.

name: JPMORGAN CHASE BANK NA
ohio_outcome: No closure. JPMorgan Chase is an active, operating bank; its parent filed four 424B2 prospectus supplements with the SEC on 2026-11-03, the day of this review.
source: SEC EDGAR submissions for JPMorgan Chase & Co, CIK 0000019617 (10-K, 10-Q and 424B2 filings continuing through 2026-11-03); Google News RSS headline 'JPMorgan Chase Faces $18.5 Million Liability in Bankruptcy Court Complaint' (Lawxy AI, 2026-10-03)
notes: False positive of the creditor/defendant type the prompt warns about. The headline itself says the bank 'faces liability in a bankruptcy court complaint', i.e. it is a defendant in someone else's case. No bankruptcy petition by JPMorgan Chase Bank NA exists.

name: BRITISH AIRWAYS PLC
ohio_outcome: Not applicable. British Airways and its parent IAG continue to operate; the liquidation in the story is the supplier's.

name: PAYCOR INC
ohio_outcome: Nothing closed. Paycor was bought by Paychex of Rochester, New York for $4.1 billion, announced January 7, 2025 and completed in mid-April 2025. The Cincinnati operation continues and its move to a downtown Cincinnati headquarters was still going ahead into 2026.
source: WCPO 2025-01-07; Cincinnati Enquirer 2025-04-17; Democrat and Chronicle 2025-04-21; The Business Journals 2025-12-16
notes: The flagged headline was about auctioning suite furniture at Paycor Stadium, which is only a naming-rights tie. Worth noting as an ownership change: an Ohio grant recipient is now owned out of state.

name: PELLA CORPORATION
ohio_outcome: Nothing closed in Ohio. Pella's Ohio plant is in Troy, a 324,000 square foot factory with 428 jobs announced in July 2020, and no coverage reports a cut there. The closure is in Reidsville, North Carolina, where 133 jobs end.

name: CROWN EQUIPMENT CORPORATION

name: US BANK NATIONAL ASSOCIATION
ohio_outcome: Nothing closed. U.S. Bank cut 65 Cincinnati jobs in February 2020, after the 2019 grant, and was closing some Cincinnati branches as of July 2026. The bank continues to operate in Ohio and received another grant in 2023.

name: OVERDRIVE INC
ohio_outcome: Nothing closed. The headline is about OverDrive's trademark suit against OpenAI over the name Sora, filed in November 2025; OpenAI is the one shutting its Sora product down. OverDrive continues to operate in Ohio.

name: Hunter Defense Technologies Inc
